observations.mechanism: git add <own> stages into ONE shared index; a bare `git commit` in another live window commits the whole index, so pathspec-only staging does not bound what leaves the index
observations.why_it_matters_here: C-10 makes the commit part of dispatch, and C-07 makes the commit message the attribution surface; a sweep puts window F's content under window O's signature while O's message asserts no foreign content was added -- both statements become unreadable at once
observations.not_a_corruption: no bytes were lost or altered; the defect is attribution + silent ownership of the blast radius
